picks.editorial_note: A multi-laboratory DOE effort under the Genesis Mission is bringing agentic AI directly into lattice QCD calculations at Fermilab, a concrete step toward AI accelerating fundamental physics discovery rather than just data analysis.

picks.title: Researchers find eight ways AI could lead to our downfall
